sloka: स्थिता पारे समुद्रस्य दूर पारस्य राघव ।नौ पथः च अपि न अस्ति अत्र निरादेशः च सर्वतः ॥६-३-२१॥।।
transliteration: sthitā pāre samudrasya dūra pārasya rāghava ।nau pathaḥ ca api na asti atra nirādeśaḥ ca sarvataḥ ॥6-3-21॥।।

translations.english: "O Raghava Lanka is located on the other shore of the ocean. Passage through the sea is not possible. It is away from all and there is nothing around."
